products.title: Roma Paris Mobility Scooter | Refurbished
products.body_html:
Refurbished, like new mobility scooter

The refurbished Roma Paris mobility scooter is a lightweight, compact, and easy-to-use solution designed for comfortable everyday travel. Professionally refurbished and fully tested by our expert engineers, this pre-owned mobility scooter offers excellent reliability and value.

Designed for indoor and outdoor pavement use, the Roma Paris dismantles quickly into lightweight sections for easy transport and storage, making it ideal for shopping trips, days out, and holidays.

Features include a comfortable padded swivel seat, flip-up armrests, adjustable tiller, puncture-proof tyres, anti-tip wheels, and split batteries for easier lifting and handling.

Please note: colours and cosmetic finish may vary. All scooters are carefully assembled, inspected, and tested to ensure safe and reliable performance.

products.title: Excel Galaxy Roadmaster Plus | Refurbished
products.body_html:
Refurbished & Like New

The refurbished Excel Galaxy Roadmaster Plus mobility scooter is a powerful and comfortable Class 3 road legal scooter designed for longer outdoor journeys. Professionally refurbished and fully tested by our expert engineers, this pre-owned mobility scooter delivers excellent performance, comfort, and reliability.

Built for stability and smooth travel, the Roadmaster Plus features upgraded suspension, a powerful 700-watt motor, and large wheels for enhanced comfort across varied terrain. The fully adjustable captain’s swivel seat with adjustable backrest ensures excellent support on longer trips, while the intuitive controls and adjustable tiller make driving simple and comfortable.

Additional features include LED front and rear lights, indicators, wing mirrors, high ground clearance, and a large front basket, making it ideal for everyday outdoor use.

Please note: colours and cosmetic finish may vary. All scooters are carefully assembled, inspected, and tested to ensure safe and reliable performance.

products.title: Roma Shoprider Cadiz | Refurbished
products.body_html:
Refurbished, like new scooter

The Shoprider Cadiz is a Class 3 road-legal mobility scooter built for users who want comfort, capability, and confidence on both pavements and roads. With a switchable 4/8mph speed setting, adjustable delta tiller, and full light set including indicators, hazard lights, and horn, it meets everything required for safe road use, and comes with rear-view mirrors included as standard.

Full all-round independent suspension and large 13-inch pneumatic tyres absorb the bumps of everyday terrain, while the fully adjustable captain's seat with four-position lockable swivel keeps long journeys comfortable. Supporting users up to 160kg (25 stone) with a range of up to 20 miles, the Cadiz is one of the most capable and reliable heavy-duty scooters at this price point.

Please note: colours and cosmetic finish may vary. All scooters are carefully assembled, inspected, and tested to ensure safe and reliable performance.

products.title: Roma Sovereign 4 Mobility Scooter | Refurbished
products.body_html:
Refurbished, like new Scooter

The Shoprider Sovereign 4 is a Class 2 pavement mobility scooter trusted across the UK for its simplicity, comfort, and reliability. It dismantles quickly for car boot storage, no tools required - making it ideal for users who need everyday independence without the hassle.

The fold-down captain's seat swivels for easy access and adjusts for height and reach, while the five-position tiller and automatic braking make driving effortless. A front shopping basket, headlight, and wing mirror are all included as standard.

With a 20-mile range and large sure-grip tyres for a smooth, stable ride, the Sovereign 4 is a proven everyday scooter. Available in Metallic Red.

Please note: colours and cosmetic finish may vary. All scooters are carefully assembled, inspected, and tested to ensure safe and reliable performance.

products.title: Rascal Ultralight 480 Mobility Scooter | Refurbished
products.body_html:
Refurbished, like new Scooter

The Rascal Ultralight 480 is a Class 2 transportable mobility scooter built for users who want genuine independence on the go. Lightweight and compact, it dismantles in seconds using quick-release locks and easy-lift handles, no cables, no tools - fitting neatly into most car boots or storing upright at home when space is tight.

The cushioned swivel seat with flip-up adjustable armrests makes getting on and off effortless, while solid puncture-proof tyres mean a reliable, maintenance-free ride every time. With up to 8 miles of range and a maximum speed of 4mph, it handles everyday journeys with ease.

Please note: colours and cosmetic finish may vary. All scooters are carefully assembled, inspected, and tested to ensure safe and reliable performance.

products.title: Quickie Q100 R Electric Wheelchair | Refurbished
products.body_html:
Refurbished, like new powerchair

The Quickie Q100 R is an ultra-compact indoor/outdoor powerchair built for everyday urban life. Designed around Quickie's SMART Base Technology, it delivers impressive agility in tight spaces - navigating narrow doorways, busy streets, and varied outdoor terrain with ease.

Ideal for first-time powerchair users, the Q100 R combines a slim, space-saving footprint with genuine outdoor capability. Its ergonomic seating, intuitive joystick control, and modern styling make it as practical as it is smart-looking.

Powered by a 24V, 12Ah battery, it offers a range of up to 19.2km (11.9 miles) per charge at up to 6km/h (4mph), supporting users up to 120kg (18.9 stone).

Book a free demonstration today and experience the Q100 R for yourself.

Please note: colours and cosmetic finish may vary. All powerchairs are carefully assembled, inspected, and tested to ensure safe and reliable performance.
